review_items.issue_03_not_permitted_files: Both cited catalogs renamed to .txt. The runtime filename is flosc_da1_catalog_{key}.tsv, built from the explicit catalog key in each pack.json, so nothing about DA1 changes. The zip carries no .tsv.
review_items.issue_05_external_services: == External Services == is now its own top-level section. The official sample readme.txt carries == A brief Markdown Example ==, so a section outside the seven the parser names is sanctioned; class-parser.php:441-445 routes it to other_notes and re-emits the title as <h3>, and :462-465 concatenates other_notes onto description, so the H2 and a sub-heading inside == Other Notes == publish identical markup. In v156 it was a sub-heading inside the faq bucket, which Parser::parse_section() renders as a definition list -- the disclosure published as a FAQ entry. Starter Packs moved to == Installation == to free the tokens that made room for it under the cap.
review_items.issue_09_nonces_and_permissions: flosc_set_status and flosc_toggle_status now name the offer, and set_status also the requested status, through flosc_offer_action_nonce_action() which both the eight links and the handler call. Submission detection split from nonce verification at four handlers in admin/settings.php and the save handler in admin/offers.php.
review_items.issue_10_sanitize_escape_validate: All five phpcs:ignore comments for WordPress.Security.ValidatedSanitizedInput removed. The ruleset's declared list is now the only place a project sanitizer is credited, and there are no EscapeOutput annotations either, so disabling every annotation for both review sniffs changes nothing they report.
